projects.title: Projects
projects.name: Name
projects.deleteFiles: Also delete the files on disk
projects.confirmDelete: Delete this project? The project and its tags are removed; the files stay on disk.
projects.confirmDeleteWithFiles: Delete this project and erase every one of its files from the disk? This cannot be undone.
projects.newSlicerProject: Start a new slicer project from
projects.curaHazardTitle: Cura never saves over the file it opened
projects.curaHazard: Cura's Ctrl+S is always Save As, and it defaults to its own folder rather than this project's. On the machine this was measured on that folder sits inside the model library, so pressing Ctrl+S and then Enter writes a copy there instead of back into this project.

import.title: Import
import.heading: Import a CuraManager library
import.intro: Zip your CuraManager library folder and drop it here. Every project folder inside becomes a project, and brings any tags, source URL and archived state it carries with it.
import.running: Importing. Large libraries take a few minutes -- leave this page open.
import.done: {{ projects }} projects and {{ files }} files imported, {{ tags }} tags applied.
import.strippedRoot: Everything was inside one folder ({{ name }}), so its contents became the library.
import.skipped: {{ count }} items were skipped because they were hidden or not inside a project folder.
import.failed: The import failed and nothing was changed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.libraryLead: Open a folder on this computer, or connect to a Slicer Project Manager server. The window reloads onto the new library.
settings.serverUrlInvalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://, with no user name or password in it.
settings.libraryFailed: That folder could not be opened as a library.
settings.connectFailed: That server could not be reached.

slicers.lead: The slicers installed on this computer, and which install of each one to launch.
slicers.windowsOnly: Slicers can only be found automatically on Windows. Add yours by hand below.
slicers.chooseWhich: {{ count }} installs of {{ name }} were found. Choose which one to launch.
slicers.chooseLabel: Which install of {{ name }} to launch
slicers.defaultLead: Used for any file that does not name a slicer of its own.
slicers.defaultNone: Nothing to choose from yet. Find or add a slicer first.
slicers.errorLoad: The slicer settings could not be loaded.
slicers.errorForbidden: Slicers can only be configured in the desktop app.
slicers.errorConflict: These slicer settings were saved by a newer version and cannot be changed here. Reset them, then search for installed slicers again.
slicers.errorNotFound: That install is no longer listed. Search for installed slicers again.
slicers.errorPickedGone: That file is no longer there. Pick it again, or choose another one.
slicers.errorValidation: That install belongs to a different slicer.
slicers.errorDetection: Looking for installed slicers did not work on this computer. Try again, or add the slicer by hand.

slicerSessions.title: Files a slicer still has
slicerSessions.lead: Every file this app has handed to a slicer and not yet finished with. Nothing here is ever removed on its own — the app compares what is on disk and waits for you.
slicerSessions.none: No slicer has anything of yours open.
slicerSessions.orphanLead: This came back from a slicer, and nothing beside it says which project it belongs to.
slicerSessions.discardStale: Throw away the {{ count }} old ones
slicerSessions.processAlive: The program this app started is still running. That is not the same as the slicer being open, and it never means the slicer was closed.
slicerSessions.processGone: The program this app started has ended. Several slicers hand the file to a copy of themselves that is already running and then exit, so this does not mean the slicer was closed.
slicerSessions.returnedAs: It went out as a {{ source }} project and came back as a {{ returned }} one.
slicerSessions.sizes: {{ before }} when it went out, {{ after }} now.
slicerSessions.diffLimit: This says which parts of the file changed, not which setting inside them did.
slicerSessions.whichProject: Which project does this belong to?
slicerSessions.curaLimit: This slicer never saves back over the file it was given, so nothing will ever come back here on its own. Save from the slicer to a folder of your own, then upload that file to the project.
slicerSessions.failedElsewhere: That file was handed to a slicer from a different library. Open that library again to answer it.
slicerSessions.failedSettling: That file is still being written. Wait a moment and check again.
slicerSessions.failed: That did not work. Nothing was added or removed.

admin.title: Users
admin.lastAdmin: The last active administrator must remain
admin.invalidQuota: Quota must be a whole number of MiB, greater than zero
admin.confirmDeleteUser: Delete this user? Their projects and file metadata are removed, but their library folder is deliberately left on disk and does not free up any space.

viewer.title: Model viewer
viewer.canvasLabel: 3D view of the model. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. With the view focused, the arrow keys rotate, + and - zoom, and 0 resets it.
viewer.noWebgl: This browser could not open a 3D view. WebGL may be switched off, or too many 3D views are already open -- reload the page and try again.
viewer.unsupported: This viewer shows {{ formats }} models, and cannot open a {{ extension }} file. Download it from the project page to open it in your slicer.
viewer.missingFile: This file is not part of this project any more. Go back to the project to see what it holds now.
viewer.fetchFailed: The model could not be downloaded. Check your connection, then reload the page to try again.
viewer.parseFailed: This file could not be read as a {{ extension }} model. It may be damaged or only partly uploaded -- try uploading it again.
viewer.emptyModel: This model contains no triangles, so there is nothing to show. The file may have been exported empty.
viewer.slicerProject: This is a slicer project rather than a plain model, so there is no single mesh here to show. Download it from the project page to open it in your slicer.
viewer.tooLarge: This model is {{ size }}. Opening a {{ extension }} file can take many times its own size in memory, and there is no way to tell how much this one needs without downloading it first -- so the viewer asks instead, and nothing has been downloaded yet.

browse.title: Find models
browse.lead: Browse a model site in this window, then add what you download to a project.
browse.openFailed: The model browser could not be opened.
browse.verifying: The site is checking the connection. That takes a few seconds and finishes on its own — the page appears when it does.
browse.noPage: Nothing is open yet. Pick a site above, or type an address.
browse.forgetLastPageHint: This window reopens on the page you left. This is what removes it.
browse.makeRoom: Discard the {{ count }} downloads that are not still running
browse.downloadRunningUnknownSize: Still downloading — {{ received }} so far. This server did not say how big the file is.
browse.downloadOrphan: Downloaded by an earlier run of this app
browse.downloadUnverifiable: Nothing can vouch for these bytes, so this cannot be added to a project. Discarding it is the only way on; downloading it again is the way to the model.
browse.fromNoPage: This came down through a pop-up window, which never said which page it was on. There is nothing to match it against, so choose the project yourself.
browse.noProjects: There are no projects yet. Create one below.
browse.suggestedLead: This looks like a project you already have. It is a suggestion — check it before adding.
browse.createAndAdd: Create it and add the file
browse.archiveLocal: That is an archive and this app does not unpack it, so the project has one zip in it and no models. To get the models out: unzip it into the project folder and rescan the library.
browse.archiveRemote: That is an archive and this app cannot unpack it from here, so the project has one zip in it and no models. The project folder is on the server: there is no folder on this computer to unzip into, a rescan rescans the server's disk, and this app cannot show you the file. Unpacking it on the machine running the server is the only way to the models inside.
browse.errorClash: That project would not take the file. If it already has one under this name, change the name above and add it again — nothing is renamed for you, because a second copy under another name would hide the fact that you already have this model.
browse.errorQuota: That would take the library over its quota.
browse.errorName: That is not a name a file can have.
browse.errorGone: That download or that project is not there any more.
browse.errorCreateName: That is not a name a project can have. It has to be between 1 and 200 characters.
browse.errorCreateRefused: The project could not be created, so nothing was added. The download is still here — try again, or add it to a project that already exists.

errors.quotaExceeded: This upload would exceed your quota ({{ usage }} of {{ quota }} used)
errors.notFound: This project does not exist any more
errors.invalidTag: A tag must be between 1 and 60 characters
errors.invalidFileName: That file name is not allowed
